observations: The whole physical page 213 / printed page 203 was directly read and compared against every candidate prose, formula, caption and footer line; no missing or substituted word was found.

Angular magnification definition and its bold term match the source. Both bold magnifier occurrences match: the first is split across two printed lines and kept inside a single bold span; the second stays on one line.
Formula varphi=h/d_0, equation number (6.20), d_0=25 centimeters and the meaning of h are preserved.

All seven lower prose lines match, including converging lens/lens group, F generally not exceeding 10 centimeters, proximity to the eye, object at the focal plane, parallel emergent beam, clear retinal image and unstressed eye. These are transcription observations, not independent scientific endorsements.
Lower formula varphi_1=h/F is preserved as a single display row, including the subscript 1 and uppercase F; it has no source equation number to add.
Figure 188 is on the left and figure 189 on the right. Both separate caption texts are retained; they occupy one shared horizontal printed row. Only the second caption carries samerow.
The final line asking for the magnifier's angular magnification ends in a comma and remains p open. This page review does not close or complete that cross-page object.
Footer 203 and its two dot ornaments are retained. ASCII full stops, spacing and centered-dot footer representation are transcription typography, not deletions of source wording.

Candidate Markdown and structured JSON contain the same nine blocks and the same words, emphasis, formulas, caption flags and open flag. Audit has 16 printed / 16 Markdown rows with empty errors, unknown characters, normalizations and KaTeX warnings.
